an7.80:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] sattahi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu vinayadharo sobhati.
an7.80:1.7: ubhayāni kho panassa pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni honti suvibhattāni suppavattīni suvinicchitāni suttaso anubyañjanaso.
an7.80:1.10: imehi kho bhikkhave, sattahi dhammehi samannāgato vinayadharo sobhatīti.
